scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Participation In Industrial Exhibitions Abroad
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Unit must be a new or existing manufacturing/service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Commercial production must have commenced between 20‑05‑2022 and 19‑05‑2027
Application must be submitted within three months of completion of the exhibition
benefits_summary: 50% space‑rent subsidy up to ₹2,00,000, payable for up to five years under IPS‑2022
